title: Elazar ben Yehudah of Avelim
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in Zevachim 28a; in Chullin 55b “of Ivelim,” and there at 122b “of Avelom”; in Tosefta Maaser Sheni, chapter 1, “of Iveliyim”; and at the end of Tosefta Niddah as “of Kefar Ovelon.”

notes.text: The consulted Zevachim and Chullin passages vary between Elazar and Eliezer and in the form of the place-name. Tosefta Maaser Sheni has איש אכלים in a different construction. The exact Tosefta Niddah form remains Hyman’s report.
